verdict.rationale: Docs and marketing show automated registration creation, filing tracking (Get/Create Filings, Create Registration APIs) and a broad claim that Kintsugi 'files everywhere you sell,' supporting core filing/remittance automation across jurisdictions. However, there is no evidence of an explicit on-time guarantee or penalty-coverage commitment, nor details on remittance mechanics or SLA terms. Missing for 10: explicit late-filing penalty guarantee, remittance process documentation, and independent verification of on-time filing performance.
